annotations.title: Change and save or submit a request

description: Change answers on one of your open requests and then Save for Later (`action: "save"`) or Submit it (`action: "submit"` — sends it on in Workday). `answers` maps a question number (or a distinctive part of the question) to the new answer; a choice must be one of its options. Unchanged answers are skipped; a submit needs every required question answered. After the write, the request is re-read to verify it. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

action.description: `save` = Save for Later (stays with you); `submit` = Submit (sends it on).

answers.description: Question number (or part of the question text) → new answer.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.
